summary: Defines AES-XCBC-PRF-128, a pseudo-random function built from the Advanced Encryption Standard, for use with the Internet Key Exchange (IKE) in IPsec. It gives implementations that already have AES a way to generate key material without adding another algorithm. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: A secret recipe that mixes ingredients in a scrambled but repeatable way. The two computers use it to cook up matching secret keys, built from a scrambler they already own.
